metadata.title: Enterprise Applications and Financial Systems Data Assets
metadata.description: Catalog of the finance data that Booking Holdings' enterprise applications and financial systems own: ledger and master data, booking and subledger records, payments and partner settlement, procurement, tax, treasury, close and reporting, controls, analytics, and architecture knowledge. Governance reflects SOX, GDPR, PCI DSS (tokenised), EU e-money safeguarding, VAT/DAC7 and SEC reporting obligations; stores and vendors marked assumed are not publicly confirmed.

rootGroups.name: Ledger and Master Data
rootGroups.description: The accounting record and the reference data that structures it.

subGroups.name: Ledger
subGroups.description: Journals and the structures they post to.

assets.name: General Ledger Journal
assets.description: Line-item universal journal across all legal entities, ledgers and currencies, including Central Finance replicated postings from brand and legacy systems.
assets.businessMeaning: The book of record for every reported number.

interfaces.name: journal posting api
interfaces.description: Validated, balanced postings from subledgers and adapters.

interfaces.name: journal-posted
interfaces.description: Posting notifications for close and analytics.

governance.sharingPolicy: Finance and auditors only; read access by role via SoD-checked roles.

assets.name: Chart of Accounts and Financial Master Data
assets.description: Global chart of accounts, brand mappings, cost centres, profit centres, segments and posting rules governed centrally.
assets.businessMeaning: The shared vocabulary that makes brand numbers comparable.

interfaces.name: master data api
interfaces.description: Lookup and validation of accounts and mappings.

governance.retention: Life of the entity plus 10 years
governance.sharingPolicy: Published to all finance systems; changes only via governed workflow.

assets.name: Legal Entity and Intercompany Register
assets.description: Legal entities, functional currencies, intercompany agreements, transfer-pricing rules and FX rates used for revaluation.
assets.businessMeaning: Who owes whom inside the group, in which currency.

interfaces.name: entity and fx api
interfaces.description: Entity attributes, intercompany partners and rates.

governance.retention: Life of the entity plus 10 years
governance.sharingPolicy: Finance, tax and treasury only.

rootGroups.name: Order-to-Cash and Revenue Data
rootGroups.description: Booking, subledger, revenue and traveller-funds data that turn transactions into revenue.

assets.name: Booking Financial Event
assets.description: Canonical finance view of a booking lifecycle event (created, modified, cancelled, stayed) from any brand: amounts, currencies, merchant or agency model, entity, partner and tax attributes.
assets.businessMeaning: The single finance contract every brand emits.
assets.accessScope: Personal fields minimised to pseudonymous IDs

interfaces.name: booking-financial-event
interfaces.description: Versioned event schema per lifecycle change.

interfaces.name: brand batch extract
interfaces.description: Fallback file feed for brands not yet event-enabled.

governance.retention: 7 years after stay date; traveller identifiers pseudonymised after 24 months
governance.sharingPolicy: Personal fields minimised to pseudonymous IDs; brands publish, finance consumes.

assets.name: Contract Account Subledger Posting
assets.description: FI-CA contract-account documents for travellers, partners and payment providers: receivables, payables, clearing and dunning at booking volume.
assets.businessMeaning: The open-item truth behind each partner and payment balance.

interfaces.name: subledger-summarised
interfaces.description: Aggregated postings transferred to the GL.

governance.sharingPolicy: Finance operations by role; summarised to GL.

assets.name: Revenue Recognition Schedule
assets.description: Per-booking performance obligations, gross-versus-net and merchant-versus-agency treatment, recognition dates and cancellation reversals under ASC 606.
assets.businessMeaning: When and how much revenue each booking earns.

interfaces.name: revenue schedule api
interfaces.description: Schedules and recognition events by booking.

governance.sharingPolicy: Accounting and audit only.

assets.name: Deferred Merchant Bookings Balance
assets.description: Cash received from travellers before the stay, by entity, currency and expected recognition date, with refund exposure. Reported at $5,270M at 31 December 2025 (10-K).
assets.businessMeaning: The liability the company holds for travellers until services are delivered.

interfaces.name: deferred bookings api
interfaces.description: Balance and roll-forward by entity and currency.

governance.sharingPolicy: Accounting, treasury and safeguarding reporting.

rootGroups.name: Payments and Settlement Data
rootGroups.description: Money in from travellers and money out to partners.

subGroups.name: Payments-to-Ledger
subGroups.description: Payment events, settlement and disputes from PSPs and acquirers.

assets.name: Payment Transaction and Settlement Record
assets.description: Normalised card-not-present and alternative-payment-method transactions, captures, refunds, fees, interchange and PSP settlement-batch lines. Card data is tokenised; only network tokens and last four digits are held.
assets.businessMeaning: What was charged, what was settled and what it cost.

interfaces.name: psp settlement file
interfaces.description: Raw PSP and acquirer reports ingested daily.

governance.retention: 10 years for accounting fields; payment personal data per PCI and GDPR minimisation
governance.sharingPolicy: Tokenised only; no PAN in finance systems.

assets.name: Reconciliation Match Result
assets.description: Three-way match outcome between booking, payment and PSP settlement, with break reason, ageing and resolution.
assets.businessMeaning: Proof that every payment reached the ledger.

governance.sharingPolicy: Finance operations, payments and controls.

assets.name: Chargeback and Refund Case
assets.description: Refund, chargeback, representment and dispute cases with scheme reason codes, liability allocation between company and partner, and accounting outcome.
assets.businessMeaning: Who bears each lost or returned payment.
assets.accessScope: Payments, customer service and finance by role.

governance.sharingPolicy: Payments, customer service and finance by role.

subGroups.name: Partner Settlement
subGroups.description: Invoices to and payouts for accommodation and travel partners.

assets.name: Partner Commission Invoice
assets.description: Monthly commission invoices to agency-model partners with lines per stay, tax, credit notes and collection status.
assets.businessMeaning: What partners owe the company for agency bookings.

interfaces.name: commission invoice api
interfaces.description: Invoices and status for partner extranets.

governance.sharingPolicy: Partner sees own invoices; finance and tax internally.

assets.name: Partner Payout Instruction
assets.description: Payout instructions for merchant-model partners: amount net of commission, currency, method (bank transfer, virtual card), value date and status.
assets.businessMeaning: What the company owes each partner and when it is paid.
assets.accessScope: Treasury, settlement operations and partner self-service.

governance.sharingPolicy: Treasury, settlement operations and partner self-service.

assets.name: Partner Bank and Payout Details
assets.description: Partner beneficiary bank accounts, verification status, payout preferences and DAC7-relevant seller identifiers. Encrypted at field level; changes need verification.
assets.businessMeaning: Where money goes, and the most fraud-sensitive partner data.

governance.sharingPolicy: Need-to-know; every change audited and dual-verified.

assets.name: Supplier Master and Contract
assets.description: Supplier records, risk screening, contracts, rate cards and approved catalogues across group entities.
assets.businessMeaning: Who we buy from and on what terms.

governance.sharingPolicy: Procurement and finance.

assets.name: AP Invoice and Payment
assets.description: Supplier invoices (including e-invoices), matching results, approvals and payment runs.
assets.businessMeaning: What we owe suppliers and what we paid.

governance.sharingPolicy: AP and finance.

assets.name: Indirect Tax Determination Record
assets.description: Per-transaction VAT, travel transaction and digital-services-tax determination with jurisdiction, rule version, basis and evidence; also DAC7 platform-seller reporting extracts.
assets.businessMeaning: Which tax applies, where, and why.

governance.retention: 10 years or local statute, whichever longer
governance.sharingPolicy: Tax and authorised auditors; filings to authorities.

assets.name: Tax Provision and Pillar Two Dataset
assets.description: Current and deferred tax provision and OECD Pillar Two GloBE effective-tax-rate calculations by jurisdiction and entity.
assets.businessMeaning: Group tax expense and minimum-tax top-up exposure.

governance.sharingPolicy: Tax and external audit.

assets.name: Cash Position and FX Exposure
assets.description: Daily bank balances, forecasted flows (traveller receipts, partner payouts, supplier runs), FX exposures by currency (principally EUR and GBP per 10-K) and hedge deals.
assets.businessMeaning: How much cash we have, where, in which currency, and how it is protected.

interfaces.name: cash position api
interfaces.description: Position and exposure by entity and currency.

governance.sharingPolicy: Treasury, CFO office.

rootGroups.name: Close, Reporting and Controls Data
rootGroups.description: Close, external reporting, planning and controls evidence.

assets.name: Account Reconciliation and Close Task
assets.description: Balance-sheet reconciliations, close checklists, journal approvals and their sign-offs per period.
assets.businessMeaning: Proof each balance was checked before results are released.

interfaces.name: close status api
interfaces.description: Task and reconciliation status per period.

governance.sharingPolicy: Accounting, controls and audit.

assets.name: Consolidated Financial Statement
assets.description: Consolidated and segment results, eliminations, disclosures and 10-K/10-Q data with XBRL tagging.
assets.businessMeaning: The numbers the company publishes.

governance.sharingPolicy: Material non-public information until filed; insider list controls.

assets.name: Plan and Forecast Dataset
assets.description: Annual plan, rolling forecasts, scenarios and driver assumptions by brand, entity and cost centre.
assets.businessMeaning: What we expect to happen and what we commit to.

governance.sharingPolicy: FP&A and leadership; MNPI handling.

assets.name: User Access and SoD Ruleset
assets.description: Role design, segregation-of-duties rules, provisioning history, firefighter access and periodic certifications across finance applications.
assets.businessMeaning: Who can do what in finance systems.

governance.sharingPolicy: Controls, IT security and audit.

assets.name: SOX Control and Evidence Record
assets.description: Key controls, owners, test procedures, results, deficiencies, remediation and links to evidence for ICFR.
assets.businessMeaning: Evidence that controls over financial reporting work.
assets.accessScope: Internal audit, controls owners, external auditor.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal audit, controls owners, external auditor.

assets.name: Safeguarded Funds Position
assets.description: Daily relevant-funds calculation and safeguarding account reconciliation for BHFS e-money institutions, with regulatory return extracts.
assets.businessMeaning: Proof that customer funds held by licensed entities are protected.

interfaces.name: regulatory return
interfaces.description: Periodic returns to the supervising authority.

governance.sharingPolicy: Regulated-entity finance and compliance; regulators on request.

rootGroups.name: Finance Analytics and Architecture Data
rootGroups.description: Shared analytical data and the architecture knowledge base.

subGroups.name: Finance Analytics
subGroups.description: Reconciled analytical data and metric definitions.

assets.name: Finance Analytical Dataset
assets.description: Reconciled, ledger-tied analytical tables (bookings, revenue, payments, costs) at transaction grain for analytics and management reporting.
assets.businessMeaning: One reconciled analytical truth instead of brand spreadsheets.

interfaces.name: sql access
interfaces.description: Governed SQL access by data product.

governance.sharingPolicy: Role-based; MNPI fenced before results release.

assets.name: Finance Metric Definition
assets.description: Certified metric definitions (gross bookings, take rate, merchant mix, DSO, close days) with lineage to ledger and source data.
assets.businessMeaning: One definition per number.

governance.sharingPolicy: Published internally.

assets.name: Architecture Decision Record
assets.description: Decisions with context, options, cost-benefit, risks, control impact, decision rights and status, linked to programmes and applications.
assets.businessMeaning: Why the landscape looks the way it does.

interfaces.name: decision api
interfaces.description: Decisions by programme, application or standard.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; shared with auditors when a control relies on it.

assets.name: Architecture Standard and Pattern
assets.description: Mandatory standards, guidelines and reusable patterns for enterprise applications and financial systems, with conformance rules and waivers.
assets.businessMeaning: The rules every finance build follows.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal, all engineering.

assets.name: Application Portfolio Inventory
assets.description: Enterprise and finance applications across brands with owner, lifecycle, cost, SOX relevance, capability mapping and target-state disposition (tolerate, invest, migrate, eliminate).
assets.businessMeaning: What we run, what it costs, and where it is going.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; cost fields restricted to leadership.

stores.name: S/4HANA Finance Database (HANA)
stores.description: SAP S/4HANA universal journal (ACDOCA) and finance master data on SAP HANA, reached through Central Finance replication from brand and legacy ledgers. Run in SAP RISE private cloud (assumed).

stores.name: FI-CA Contract Accounting Store
stores.description: SAP FI-CA/BRIM contract accounts, posting documents and convergent invoicing tables for high-volume booking, payment and partner transactions.

stores.name: Finance Event Streams
stores.description: Durable topics carrying booking-financial, payment-settlement, payout and tax events from brands and payment services into the finance core.

stores.name: Finance Lakehouse (FinDB)
stores.description: Governed analytical store for finance-grade, reconciled datasets and metric definitions. FinDB is named only in a third-party job listing, so its role here is assumed.

stores.name: Payments-to-Ledger Operational DB
stores.description: Normalised payment, settlement-file, match-result and dispute records before posting to the subledger.

stores.name: Partner Settlement DB
stores.description: Commission invoices, payout instructions and tokenised partner bank details, with payout status history.

stores.name: Treasury Management System
stores.description: Treasury workstation tenant holding bank balances, cash positions, FX exposures and hedge deals.

stores.name: Close and Consolidation SaaS Tenants
stores.description: Account reconciliation / close task tenant and consolidation / planning tenant. BlackLine and OneStream appear in a third-party listing, so the vendors are assumed.

stores.name: Source-to-Pay SaaS Tenant
stores.description: Procurement, supplier onboarding, contract and invoice-capture tenant integrated with S/4HANA AP.

stores.name: GRC and Controls Repository
stores.description: Control library, SoD rulesets, access certifications, test results and audit evidence references.

stores.name: Finance Document Archive
stores.description: Immutable WORM archive of invoices, statements, filings and evidence packs for statutory and SOX retention.

stores.name: Architecture Repository
stores.description: Decision records, standards, pattern catalog, application portfolio and target-state models.
